label: Average Band A Council Tax, England (£ per year)
publisher: MHCLG (DLUHC) – Council Tax levels set by local authorities in England
methodology: Average Band D for the area, including parish precepts and the adult social care precept. Key = year the financial year starts (2025 = 2025-26). 2002-2011 are from the frozen 2011-12 release (https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5a796f41ed915d042206863f/1870223.xls); 2012 onward refreshed from the latest release. Band A = Band D x 6/9, the fixed statutory ratio for England (applies equally to every authority).
limitations: England only (Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland have different systems). Band D is a reference band, not what the typical household pays: most English homes are in Bands A-C, so the average bill is lower. 1993-2001 not integrated. Council Tax benefit/reduction is not modelled. Derived arithmetically, not separately published as an England average.
